cohort: 104 healthy neonates, 30 neonates in the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU), and 40 adults
finding: Neonates have higher TEWL than adults, suggesting that the epidermal barrier is still adapting to extrauterine life.
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in TEWL between neonates born via normal vaginal birth and caesarean section.
